---
name: disclosure-check
description: Review Ventura Art publication material for repository-documented AI disclosure and platform compliance requirements. Use when generated media is about to be published or campaign guidance is being updated. Do not use when no publication or disclosure decision is involved.
---

# Disclosure check

- Read `conformidade/divulgacao-ia.md` before making a recommendation.
- Identify the target platform market and publication context.
- Treat repository compliance notes as operational references that may require current external verification.
- Separate mandatory requirements from recommended transparency practices.
- Flag stale or uncertain platform rules instead of asserting them as current.
- Keep vendor names as compatibility references and never imply affiliation or certification.
